mapper.sql: WHERE a.deleted = false AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.type = 'ARTICLE' AND (a.title ILIKE '%' || #{kw} || '%' OR a.summary ILIKE '%' || #{kw} || '%' OR a.content ILIKE '%' || #{kw} || '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.slug, a.title, a.summary, a.content, c.name AS category_name, a.created_at FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id
ORDER BY GREATEST(word_similarity(#{kw}, a.title) * 2, word_similarity(#{kw}, a.summary), word_similarity(#{kw}, a.content) * 0.3) DESC, a.published_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
